steps.do: 3 on sheep, 3 on gold with a house and mining camp
Rally to food until you age up
Prelate inspires the gold villagers once, then food

feudal.name: Meinwerk aggression
feudal.pick: Against fast Castle and greedy builds

steps.do: Gold villagers build Meinwerk; 7 to wood
5 to deer with Survival Techniques if it's close
Barracks + range. Spear-archer vs FC, MAA-archer vs horsemen

castle.name: Burgrave push
castle.pick: You did damage; turn it into an infantry flood

steps.do: Age once they reach Castle or you've done damage
Burgrave makes infantry 400% faster; push with MAA and spears

castle.goal: Contain them in their base with constant infantry

castle.name: Regnitz relics
castle.pick: They held; switch to relics and gold

steps.do: Farms, stable, second prelate for relics
Regnitz doubles relic gold

castle.goal: Relic gold carries you into Imperial

feudal.name: Aachen 2 TC
feudal.pick: Safe maps, or against slow civs

steps.do: Aachen 2 tiles from wood; gold villagers to stone
Prelate inspires the stone villagers
Feudal: build TC 2 with 14 to 15 villagers
Farms, one TC rallies to gold
Outpost on gold; Horticulture, Wheelbarrow, Broadaxe
12 farms, then age up; second prelate

castle.name: Burgrave relics
castle.pick: Default: secure relics with MAA and spears

steps.do: Burgrave with 6 villagers, then back to food
Monastery, blacksmith, walls; relics with prelates

castle.goal: Relics and map control, Imperial with 2 TCs

castle.name: Regnitz greed
castle.pick: Relics are open and nobody is pressuring

steps.do: Regnitz plus monasteries near resources
Cistercian Churches: each monastery becomes a mini Aachen

castle.goal: Double relic gold, then Palace of Swabia in Imperial
